Each PDF page is a two-page spread, so one PDF page carries two printed page numbers. Citations use the PDF page index.

The text layer often separates headings and list letters from their paragraphs. Section labels on rule citations were confirmed against the rendered page. Page-level headings on other chunks only say which headings occur on that page.
